lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible. Posterior to the gill slits, a prominent quad of spots forms a trapezoidal arrangement where inter-spot spacing is approximately 1.5 to 2.0 times the spot diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like pattern, with highest intensity maxima located at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges (carinae) are visible. The central ridge displays the sharpest vertical luminance gradient, transitioning from high intensity on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side of the ridge line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The first dorsal fin exhibits a significant truncation or notch at its apex. A faint, horizontal linear feature is visible on the mid-flank posterior to the first dorsal fin, suggesting a possible healed contact mark.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
